mapper.select: SELECT CT_LNB_IDX AS ctLnbIdx, CT_LNB_ID AS ctLnbId, CT_LNB_NAME AS ctLnbName, CT_LNB_SUB_YN AS ctLnbSubYn, CT_LNB_URL AS ctLnbUrl, CT_LNB_USE_YN AS ctLnbUseYn FROM CT_LNB WHERE CT_LNB_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CT_LNB_IDX

SELECT CT_LNB_SUB_IDX AS ctLnbSubIdx, CT_LNB_ID AS ctLnbId, CT_LNB_SUB_ID AS ctLnbSubId, CT_LNB_SUB_NAME AS ctLnbSubName, CT_LNB_SUB_URL AS ctLnbSubUrl FROM CT_LNB_SUB WHERE CT_LNB_ID = #{id} ORDER BY CT_LNB_SUB_IDX
